code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

qr = QuantumRegister(2, "q")
cr = ClassicalRegister(2, "c")
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])
with qc.switch(cr) as case:
    with case(1, 2):
        qc.x(0)
    with case(case.DEFAULT):
        qc.z(1)
qc.draw("mpl")

A.alt: Circuit diagram on wires q_0, q_1 and a 2-bit classical register c: H on both qubits, each measured into c, then a Switch box on c with three regions — Case 1 holding an X on q_0, Case 2 holding an X on q_0, and Case default holding a Z on q_1.

B.alt: Circuit diagram on wires q_0, q_1 and a 2-bit classical register c: H on both qubits, each measured into c, then a Switch box on c with two regions — Case 1 holding an X on q_0, and Case default holding a Z on q_1.

C.alt: Circuit diagram on wires q_0, q_1 and a 2-bit classical register c: H on both qubits, each measured into c, then a Switch box on c with two regions — Case 1, 2 holding an X on q_0, and Case default holding a Z on q_1.

D.alt: Circuit diagram on wires q_0, q_1 and a 2-bit classical register c: H on both qubits, each measured into c, then a Switch box on c with one region — Case 1, 2 holding an X on q_0 — followed by a Z on q_1 outside the box.

explanation.correct: `case(1, 2)` opens ONE case block that matches either register value, so the switch box holds a single Case region labelled with both values, holding the X on q_0. `case.DEFAULT` adds a second region, labelled default, holding the Z on q_1, and it sits inside the switch: only one block ever runs, so there is no fall-through.

distractors.A: Values split into blocks: listing two values does not create two cases; it is one block whose body is shared, so the drawer shows one region labelled 1, 2.
distractors.B: Read like `range(1, 2)`: the arguments are a list of values, not a start and stop, so value 2 is matched too and is printed on the case label.
distractors.D: C-style fall-through: the DEFAULT body is its own block inside the switch and runs only when no case matched; it is not code placed after the switch.

import io

import matplotlib

matplotlib.rcParams["svg.hashsalt"] = "proof"  # deterministic SVG ids
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def drawing(circ):
    """The actual mpl rendering, as SVG text (what the option image shows)."""
    fig = circ.draw(output="mpl")
    buf = io.StringIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format="svg", metadata={"Date": None})
    plt.close(fig)
    return buf.getvalue()


# Block MUST mirror data/figures/s3-q073/generate.py (variant()).
from qiskit import ClassicalRegister, QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister


def variant(key):
    qr = QuantumRegister(2, "q")
    cr = ClassicalRegister(2, "c")
    qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)
    qc.h(0)
    qc.h(1)
    qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])
    if key == "A":    # case(1, 2) split into two separate case blocks
        with qc.switch(cr) as case:
            with case(1):
                qc.x(0)
            with case(2):
                qc.x(0)
            with case(case.DEFAULT):
                qc.z(1)
    elif key == "B":  # case(1, 2) read like range(1, 2): value 1 only
        with qc.switch(cr) as case:
            with case(1):
                qc.x(0)
            with case(case.DEFAULT):
                qc.z(1)
    elif key == "C":  # the stem code: one case block listing 1, 2
        with qc.switch(cr) as case:
            with case(1, 2):
                qc.x(0)
            with case(case.DEFAULT):
                qc.z(1)
    elif key == "D":  # C-style fall-through: default body runs after the switch
        with qc.switch(cr) as case:
            with case(1, 2):
                qc.x(0)
        qc.z(1)
    return qc



# the stem code, verbatim
qr = QuantumRegister(2, "q")
cr = ClassicalRegister(2, "c")
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])
with qc.switch(cr) as case:
    with case(1, 2):
        qc.x(0)
    with case(case.DEFAULT):
        qc.z(1)
stem_svg = drawing(qc)


def sig(circ):
    """Switch structure: case values with body gates (outer qubit indices), plus ops after it."""
    out, after, seen = [], [], False
    for inst in circ.data:
        op = inst.operation
        if op.name == "switch_case":
            seen = True
            for values, body in op.cases_specifier():
                vals = ["default" if not isinstance(v, int) else v for v in values]
                gates = [(i.operation.name,
                          [circ.find_bit(inst.qubits[body.find_bit(b).index]).index for b in i.qubits])
                         for i in body.data]
                out.append((vals, gates))
        elif seen:
            after.append((op.name, [circ.find_bit(b).index for b in inst.qubits]))
    return {"cases": out, "after_switch": after}


stem_sig = sig(qc)
proven, evidence, observed = [], {}, {"stem": stem_sig}
for key in "ABCD":
    v = variant(key)
    s = sig(v)
    same_render = drawing(v) == stem_svg
    match = s == stem_sig and same_render
    observed[key] = s
    evidence[key] = (f"case blocks {s['cases']}, ops after the switch {s['after_switch']}; "
                     f"stem code builds {stem_sig['cases']} with {stem_sig['after_switch']} after; "
                     f"mpl rendering identical to the stem's -> {same_render}; match={match}")
    if match:
        proven.append(key)

emit_verdict({"answer": proven, "evidence": evidence, "observed": observed})
